speaker: Rufus
original_jp: まさか今すぐクレルモンフェランへ行こうなんて言わないよな？
original_en:
You're not gonna say something crazy
like "Let's go to Crell Monferaigne
right away," are you?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …ああ
original_en: Well...

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 〓が明けるまで〓もう
original_en: We will rest until daybreak.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …なぜ私だと？
original_en: How did you know it was me?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: …眼でわかったわ
original_en: I can tell by your eyes.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: かなり前から入れ〓わってたんじゃない？
original_en: You switched a while ago, didn't you?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …なかなかの〓〓眼ね
original_en: How observant of you.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: アリーシャは〓れぬ長旅に疲れ切ってかなり深く〓っているわ
original_en:
Alicia's not accustomed to long
journeys. She's exhausted.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: あなたも… かなりお疲れのご様子
original_en: You seem quite fatigued as well.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: これはアリーシャの肉体であって私の肉体ではないから <PART> ――
original_en:
That's because this flesh is Alicia's.
It's not my body.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: こうして長く〓〓に止まるのも楽ではないの…
original_en:
It's an effort for me to remain on the
surface.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 少し〓むといいわ…
original_en: You should rest.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …すまない
original_en: Forgive me.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …皆には迷惑のかけどおしね
original_en: I've been a burden on all of you.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …なんだか今日は弱気だな
original_en: Hey, you getting all timid on us now?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 私はあなた達が思うほど強くない不完全な存在なのだから…
original_en:
I'm not as strong as you all think.
Mine is an incomplete existence...

speaker: Leone
original_jp: この地上に完全なものなどないでしょ
original_en: Well, nobody's perfect, right?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: ありがとう 楽になった…
original_en: Thank you, I feel better now.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 姉のような〓れみとはこういうものなのだろうか…
original_en: This must be what sisterly love feels like.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: …さあ

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 私はずっと一人だったから…
original_en: I wouldn't know. I've always been alone.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ここは！？
original_en: Where are we?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: …また入れ〓わったの！？
original_en: Oh, you're back.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …すみません
original_en: Sorry.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 〓分 長く〓っていました…
original_en: I was asleep a really long time.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: シルメリアは疲れて〓てしまったわよ
original_en: Silmeria passed out from the fatigue.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: あなたももう一〓りしたら？〓明けまでそれほど長くないわ
original_en:
Why don't you try resting for a while?
Dawn is not far off.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ありがとうございます
original_en: You're very kind.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …あの
original_en: Umm...

speaker: Leone
original_jp: なぁに？
original_en: What is it?

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: あなたが探してる物って…
original_en: The treasure that you're seeking...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: ち 違うんです！ 私は信じてます
original_en: N-no, it's me. I trust you, but <PART> ----

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: でも <PART> ――
original_en: Well...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: もしオーブのまわりに宝物がなければあなたとアリューゼは…
original_en:
If there isn't any treasure around the
orb, what will you and Arngrim do?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 代わりにオーブをよこせと言い出さないか心配なの？
original_en:
You're worried that we'll demand the orb
as compensation?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: …あなたを困らせる事はしない
original_en: We won't cause you any trouble.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …よかった
original_en: That's good.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …なんだってディパンは神と敵対しようってんだ？
original_en:
What's all this about Dipan taking on
the gods?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: ディパンの神々への〓念は 〓日今日に始まった事じゃない…
original_en:
Dipan's grudge against the gods isn't
something that just arose overnight.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: かつてヴァルキリーがディパンの〓王を無理〓理エインフェリアとして連れ去り
original_en:
It is said a valkyrie once forced a wise king
to become an einherjar and took him away.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 王家のみならず領民にも深い悲しみをもたらしたという <PART> ――
original_en:
It brought great sorrow to the royal
family and the people as well.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …よくご存じですね
original_en: How do you know about that?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: それも〓臣として当然の教〓なのか？
original_en:
Let me guess. "Common knowledge for
loyal subjects"?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: …そういう事だ
original_en: Basically, yes.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: いつ頃の話なんだ？
original_en: When did all this take place?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 〓〓〓年ほど前か…
original_en: About two hundred years ago.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: ディパンの王族ってのはよっぱど〓念深いんだな
original_en:
Huh. The royal family sure does hold
a grudge.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: それは違う
original_en: It's not that.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 記憶が風化する前に オーディンは度々人間への横暴を繰り返している <PART> ――
original_en:
Odin has terrorized humans throughout
time. He never lets us forget who rules us.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: そういうのが〓もり〓もって神々〓しの〓念になっているんだろう
original_en:
The gods have earned the hatred of the people
by heaping wrong upon wrong upon them.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …あんた一体 いつの人間だったんだ？
original_en: Huh. When did you live as a human?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 俺はたかだか〓〓〓年ほど前だ
original_en: No more than a hundred years ago.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …何の話だ？
original_en: Did I miss something?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: そっか あんたまだ知らなかったのか…
original_en:
Oh, yeah. Guess we haven't told you
about that yet.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: ディランはシルメリアが選定したエインフェリアなんだぜ
original_en:
Our friend Dylan here is an einherjar.
He was chosen by Silmeria.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 何だって！？
original_en: You serious?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: よさないか 気持ち悪い…
original_en: Hey, stop that.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: い いや…
original_en: Oh, sorry <PART> ----

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: エインフェリアなんて初めて見るからさ…
original_en:
It's just that I've never seen an
einherjar before...

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: これまで何日ずっと一緒にいたと思ってるんだ？
original_en: Really? It doesn't take much to impress you, does it?
